q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Sales did not drop yesterday — Net sales rose from ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12 to ₹91,220 on 2026-10-13 (≈+127%), so the premise is reversed: revenue spiked, not fell.

What changed (ordered by impact)
- Volume and conversion: Orders rose 26 → 45 (+73%), and sessions were roughly steady (3,254 → 3,434), so conversion improved (conversion rate 0.46% → 1.08%). This explains ~66% of the sales increase.
- Higher basket value: Net AOV rose ₹1,543 → ₹2,027 (+31%), accounting for ~34% of the uplift — more units per order and higher price per order both moved up.
- Platform concentration: Meta ad-driven sales jumped (Net sales meta ₹6,290 → ₹47,854), contributing ~81% of the change by platform — a strong paid-media uplift on one channel.
- Products / ads to check: notable movers include ad TH-152-TANGLELEASH_SI207_BN537 (₹0 → ₹2,263), ad DOG TOYS-CS (₹593 → ₹4,345), and a new shipping-state contribution from MADHYA PRADESH (₹0 → ₹3,537).
